versions.changelog:
Initial release of rocket-mass-heater-construction:

- Guides users to custom-build a rocket mass heater using local materials and proven designs for off-grid, high-efficiency heating.
- Agent handles research on local codes, adapts build plans to user’s space/materials, generates phased material lists, safety checklists, and build logs.
- Includes a detailed step-by-step protocol: planning, core construction, thermal mass bench build, installation, and optimization.
- Provides templates for material calculations, project progress tracking, and supplier communication.
- Specifies clear human vs agent roles and maintains safety protocols throughout all build phases.
